notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in the network policy hot-reload component where a local attacker with low privileges could bypass updated network policy restrictions through existing L7-inspected tunnels that continue to use the previous policy after a reload. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: data tampering, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

cwe.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in the L7 path allowlist enforcement component where a local attacker with low privileges could cause path traversal by using semicolon-dot path sequences to bypass allowlist restrictions. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: data tampering, denial of service, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in resource-level authorization for create, read, update, and delete operations where an authenticated remote attacker with low privileges could access or modify resources without the required authorization checks. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: data tampering, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in L7 policy enforcement for HTTP CONNECT tunnels where a local attacker with low privileges could cause a protection mechanism failure by using nonstandard HTTP methods to bypass policy restrictions. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: data tampering, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in the sandbox SSH authentication component where a remote attacker with high privileges could gain unauthorized access to other sandboxes by using an SSH handshake secret shared across sandboxes. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: data tampering, denial of service, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

cwe.name: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information in an Environment Variable

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in the Kubernetes sandbox SSH authentication configuration where a local attacker with low privileges could obtain sensitive authentication information by accessing an SSH handshake secret stored in a plaintext environment variable and reuse the shared secret to gain unauthorized access to other sandboxes. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: data tampering, denial of service, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in Kubernetes network policy enforcement where a local attacker with low privileges could cause the proxy to attribute network traffic to a different process due to TCP source-port identity confusion, allowing the attacker to bypass process-based network policy restrictions. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: data tampering, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

cwe.name: Inconsistent Interpretation of HTTP Requests ('HTTP Request/Response Smuggling')

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in L7 REST policy enforcement where a local attacker with low privileges could exploit inconsistent HTTP interpretation by using cleartext HTTP/2 (h2c) over an HTTP CONNECT tunnel to bypass policy restrictions. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: data tampering, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in its gateway-to-sandbox transport where a network attacker positioned on the internal path could intercept credentials and tamper with commands and data because the transport accepts any host key without verification, permitting a machine-in-the-middle to impersonate the sandbox endpoint. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure, data tampering, and code execution.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: code execution, data tampering, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in its command-line diagnostic interface where an attacker could cause OS command injection because user- or configuration-supplied values are incorporated into a command that is interpreted by two successive shell layers in the remote path while being escaped for only one layer. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, escalation of privileges, information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: code execution, escalation of privileges, data tampering, denial of service, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in its gateway connection-proxy component where an attacker who can manipulate a sandbox's status metadata could cause the control-plane server to initiate connections to arbitrary internal hosts because the connection target is derived from that metadata and used without validation against the expected address range. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: data tampering, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

cwe.name: Inconsistent Interpretation of HTTP Requests ('HTTP Request/Response Smuggling')

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in its layer-7 REST proxy where a sandboxed actor could bypass the proxy's policy enforcement by sending a request whose body framing is interpreted differently by the proxy and the upstream server, allowing a second request to be smuggled past policy checks. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to data tampering and information disclosure.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: data tampering, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for Linux contains a vulnerability in its inference-interception request parser where a sandboxed actor could exhaust processing resources by sending a chunked request that lacks body-size and chunk-count limits, causing excessive parsing work. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to denial of service.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: denial of service
notes.title: Impacts
